CFML Language Reference: Functions

InputBaseN

Reads a string as a number written in base 2 through 36 and returns its decimal value. Letters may be upper or lower case.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

InputBaseN(string, radix)

Parameters

string
The digits of the number, optionally with a leading minus sign, for example "FF" or "1010".
radix
The base the string is written in, from 2 to 36.

Returns

An integer.

Usage

A string containing a digit that is not valid in the radix (such as "12G" in base 16), or an empty string, raises an Expression error. Wrap user input in CFTRY or check it first. FormatBaseN converts the other way.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>string</TH><TH>radix</TH><TH>InputBaseN</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="args" LIST="1010:2,777:8,FF:16,cafe:16,ZZ:36">
<CFSET s = ListFirst(args, ":")><CFSET r = ListLast(args, ":")>
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD><TT>#s#</TT></TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#r#</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#InputBaseN(s, r)#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
<CFTRY>
  <CFSET x = InputBaseN("12G", 16)>
  <CFCATCH TYPE="Expression">
    <CFOUTPUT><P><I>"12G" is not hexadecimal:</I> #CFCATCH.Message#</CFOUTPUT>
  </CFCATCH>
</CFTRY>
